ns2:section.sectionText: Synchronous attendance required. Moodle & Microsoft Teams LMS. TITLE: Building Your Teaching Toolbox II: Instructional Planning STUDENTS MUST REGISTER FOR SECTION NL1 IN ORDER TO TAKE NL2. This course prepares you to walk into your future classroom with confidence in your ability to plan meaningful, engaging learning experiences for young children that produce evidence you can assess in reliable and valid ways that inform your future instruction. This course will help you build skills and resources that will support you in your methods courses, clinical experiences, student teaching…and in your future classroom. The format for this course is blended. As specified in the course schedule course meetings will be face-to-face, online, and time will be provided for group work expectations. Please note: this course is restricted to COE undergrad teacher licensure majors (Early Childhood, Elementary Education, Middle Level Education, & Special Education).
